title: Growth moment roadmap and manager prep
content:
Context and goal:
I want a compact, manager-friendly plan that summarizes the last 12 months of impact, the concrete asks I will make (scope/title/comp), and a fallback path if the full ask isn’t possible. This file is a scratchpad for the conversation — short bullets, evidence snippets, and a 10-minute script I can use in the meeting.

Principles I want to follow in the conversation:
- Be specific and outcome-focused: tie every ask to measurable team/customer outcomes.
- Keep the ask binary and tiered: Primary ask / Alternate ask / Development ask.
- Offer trade-offs (take on X responsibility or accept phased comp review).
- Close with a timeline and next steps.

High-level summary (30s elevator):
- Role: Senior People Ops (scope: onboarding, calibration, manager enablement across Eng & Product ~80 ppl).
- Impact: Reduced time-to-full-productivity for new hires by ~22% through the onboarding redesign; improved calibration alignment (score delta +0.3) via new rubrics; ran 3 manager cohorts leading to 17 one-off escalations closed faster.
- Ask: Title change to Sr. People Ops Partner, comp band move to mid-senior band (+12% target), scope bump to include cross-functional manager L&D roadmap ownership.

Evidence map (one-line snippets, cite artifacts):
- Onboarding redesign: cut 'time-to-first-ship' from 10w to 7.8w (data: onboarding-metrics Q4 2025) — link to CONFLUENCE-1234.
- Calibration rubric: introduced rubric adopted by Eng+Product; calibration variance decreased 18% across teams (source: calibration-retros Dec 2025).
- Manager cohorts: 3 cohorts run (35 managers), post-survey NPS +20, escalation closure SLA improved from 6d to 3.5d (JIRA-PO-6712).
- Cross-functional projects: led org-level project to standardize offer manager checklists and manager 30/60/90 templates (artifact: offer-checklist PR).
- Mentoring & capacity: 1:1 mentoring for 6 managers; 4 promoted to L3->L4 in last cycle (see promotion-logs).

Concrete asks (tiered):
- Primary (ideal): title -> Sr. People Ops Partner; comp -> move to band M4 (target +12%); formal ownership -> manager enablement roadmap + two direct reports (PM and Program Manager). Implementation in next quarter, retro in 6 months.
- Alternate (if immediate comp limited): keep current title, agree to comp review in 4 months tied to agreed milestones (onboarding metric improvement +2% points; launch cross-team L&D pilot).
- Development ask (if scope cannot expand): a 6-month stretch assignment to lead a prioritized project (L&D pilot) with a clear success rubric and a guaranteed band review on success.

Trade-offs I can offer:
- Take ownership of cross-team L&D pilot (design + pilot + measurement).
- Accept phased comp (50% now, remainder on milestone).
- Defer hiring request for direct report for one quarter if given clearer scope + roadmap authority.

Anticipated manager reactions and prep responses:
- "We can’t offer title now": Acknowledge; push for documented timeline and concrete milestones for band review. Ask: What are the exact outcomes we need to see in 3–4 months?
- "Budget constraints": Offer phased comp and commit to leading revenue-aligned projects (reduce ramp time for new hire engineers) to demonstrate ROI.
- "Need more evidence": Offer a short dashboard for the next 6 weeks with weekly updates and 2 short demos of cohort outcomes.

10-minute meeting script (timed):
- 0:00–1:00 quick elevator: scope + impact summary + ask.
- 1:00–3:00 evidence: 3 quick bullets (onboarding reduction, calibration result, manager cohort NPS).
- 3:00–5:00 ask: primary ask + rationale (how it helps org).
- 5:00–7:00 trade-offs and alternatives (show willingness to phase).
- 7:00–9:00 align on next steps and metrics (what success looks like & timelines).
- 9:00–10:00 close: confirm follow-ups & owners.

Success metrics (what I will deliver if granted scope/comp):
- Reduce onboarding time-to-first-ship by an additional 5–8% in next quarter.
- Establish a repeatable manager cohort with retention of cohort managers +10% vs baseline.
- Deliver pilot L&D curriculum with measured manager competency lift (survey delta +0.15).

Immediate to-dos (before the meeting):
- Prep a one-page PDF one-pager (2/3 of page) with elevator + evidence + ask ( deadline: 2026-03-02).
- Share the JIRA list of cohort outcomes and short-case artifacts with manager two days before meeting.
- Build a tiny dashboard (sheet) showing onboarding TL metrics and calibration delta (deadline: 2026-03-01).

Backups and follow-up cadence:
- If manager asks for more time: set 4-week sync cadence with biweekly short updates.
- If they request peer-level validation: schedule a 15-min sync with Head of Eng (offer to send summary in advance).

Personal coaching cues (notes to self):
- Use data-first language. Keep emotional stories to 1 quick anecdote.
- Avoid getting defensive; treat any pushback as a signal for negotiation.
- Close with an explicit next-step owner and date.

Open questions I want to resolve in the meeting:
- Will scope change come with headcount or authority only?
- What exact comp band is feasible and the timeline for implementation?
- Which stakeholders should be pulled into the decision loop (Finance, Head of Eng, People Ops Director)?

Draft follow-up email (post-meeting):
Hi [Manager],
Thanks for the time today. Per our conversation, here are the agreed next steps and owners:
- [X] — Diego: share onboarding dashboard by 2026-03-01
- [Y] — Manager: confirm funding check with Finance by 2026-03-08
- [Z] — People Ops Director: align on pilot scope by 2026-03-10
I’ll also send the one-pager and evidence links. Looking forward to iterating.

Notes and thought fragments (scratch):
- If they ask for a non-comp ask (title only), consider asking for a public role charter and ability to list new responsibilities in Org Chart.
- Possible denominator: frame comp uplift as cost saved per month via reduced ramp and fewer escalations.
- Keep one internal testimonial ready (short quote from Eng manager).

End of doc — this is a living scratchpad. Versioning: I will snapshot the one-pager when finalized and attach the PDF to CONFLUENCE-1234 and JIRA-PO-6712.
